Public.Name: Init
Public.Source: const input = document.createElement("input");    input.type = "file";    input.webkitdirectory = true;    input.style.display = "none";    const button = document.createElement("button");    button.textContent = "Selecionar Pasta";    button.className = "gx-btn btn btn-secondary";    button.onclick = function () {      input.click();    };    input.addEventListener("change", function () {      if (input.files.length > 0) {        // Pegando o primeiro caminho de pasta como exemplo        const fullPath = input.files[0].webkitRelativePath;        const folder = fullPath.split("/")[0];        UC.DirectoryPath = folder;        gx.fx.obs.notify("DirectorySelected");      }    });    this.getContainerControl().appendChild(button);    this.getContainerControl().appendChild(input);
